Hi Jill —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise summary and I've attached an anonymized sample CSV export (redwood_admin_audit_sample_202607.csv). If you need a Splunk/Datadog format or direct S3 delivery we can set that up; details further down.

Summary of what we log (admin activity telemetry):
- Authentication events: successful/failed console logins, SSO assertions, MFA challenges.
- Identity changes: role grants/revokes, group membership changes, service account key creation/rotation/deletion.
- API key usage: issuance, last-used timestamp, usage by request id (no key material in logs).
- Configuration & policy changes: model version pinning, routing policy updates, autoscale config edits, quota changes.
- Deployment actions: model uploads, quantization profile changes, rollout canary start/stop, rollback events, dedicated pool allocations.
- Data-plane admin actions: export requests, cache invalidation, KV cache flushes.
- System & operational: node-level agent restarts, autoscaler decisions (annotated), internal errors tied to request ids.

Retention and access controls:
- Default retention: 180 days for admin activity telemetry.
- Extended retention: configurable up to 3 years for Dedicated/Private customers (contract add-on).
- Access: logs are immutable once written; access via role-based permissions and time-limited signed URLs for exports.
- Deletion: we do not delete entries retroactively; retention expiry results in secure deletion per policy and KMS-wrapped deletion keys.

Export options (we can provide evidence in any combination):
- One-off exports: CSV or newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) with standard column set (timestamp, actor, actor_type, action, target, request_id, ip, user_agent, region, outcome).
- Streaming: syslog-forwarding or secure HTTP(s) webhook; compatible with Splunk HEC and Datadog intake.
- Cloud delivery: direct S3/GCS bucket export (customer-owned bucket via cross-account role) — recommended for large exports.
- API: audit log retrieval API (paginated) with filters by time range, actor, action type, request_id. Supports signed URL exports.
- Scheduling: recurring exports (daily/weekly/monthly) delivered to customer bucket or via SFTP.

PII / sensitive data handling:
- Logs never contain raw request payloads or model outputs.
- We redact or hash identifiers flagged as sensitive by default; customer-configurable redaction rules available for Private deployments.
- IPs are stored in full for 90 days then truncated to /24 for remaining retention period (configurable by contract).

Next steps / ask:
- Attached CSV is anonymized and matches the CSV export field set.
- If you want S3 delivery, please share a write-only bucket ARN and the timeframe.
- For SIG attachments: we can provide an exported sample, our audit log schema doc (export_instructions.md), and a short attestation statement for SOC2 controls.

Marissa / Rishi — can you confirm we can provide a sample Splunk HEC tokenized file if Acme asks for Splunk ingestion? Also, confirm if we can extend retention to 3 years under the existing Dedicated addendum for Acme.

Best,
Laura Bennett
